amboseli.summary: Renowned for its free-ranging elephant herds set against the dramatic backdrop of Africa's highest peak.
amboseli.signatureExperience: Photographic sunrise drives with elephants framing Mount Kilimanjaro
amboseli.bestTime: June to October and January to February for clear mountain views.
amboseli.name: Amboseli National Park

diani.summary: Voted Africa's leading beach destination multiple times, combining tropical relaxation with marine adventures and Swahili hospitality.
diani.signatureExperience: Dhow sailing and snorkeling at Kisite-Mpunguti Marine Reserve
diani.name: Diani Beach
diani.bestTime: October to April for calm seas and crystal clear water visibility.
diani.tagline: Powder-white sands and warm Indian Ocean

lake-nakuru.name: Lake Nakuru National Park
lake-nakuru.summary: A compact ecological haven featuring thriving populations of black and white rhinos and millions of flamingos along the alkaline lake shores.
lake-nakuru.bestTime: Year-round; dry months of July–September provide optimal wildlife trails.
lake-nakuru.signatureExperience: Tracking white and black rhinos in the acacia woodlands

maasai-mara.summary: World-famous for the Great Wildebeest Migration and exceptional year-round big cat sightings across sweeping savannahs.
maasai-mara.signatureExperience: Dawn game drives during the Great Migration river crossing
maasai-mara.tagline: The crown jewel of African wildlife
maasai-mara.bestTime: July to October for migration; year-round for resident big cats.
maasai-mara.name: Maasai Mara National Reserve

mount-kenya.tagline: The sacred frosted peaks of Kirinyaga
mount-kenya.signatureExperience: Trekking through the giant lobelia and alpine tarns towards Point Lenana
mount-kenya.bestTime: January–February and July–September for clear alpine conditions.
mount-kenya.name: Mount Kenya National Park
mount-kenya.summary: Africa's second-highest summit, featuring Afro-alpine flora, glacial tarns, and sacred forests steeped in Kikuyu lore.

image.alt: nairobi national park Kenya destination photography

samburu.bestTime: June to October and December to March.
samburu.name: Samburu National Reserve
samburu.tagline: Arid beauty and the Samburu Special Five
samburu.signatureExperience: Encountering the rare Grevy's zebra and reticulated giraffe along the riverbank
samburu.summary: A rugged, dramatic northern landscape intersected by the Ewaso Ng'iro river, home to species found nowhere else in southern Kenya.

tsavo-west.summary: A dramatic volcanic landscape of ancient lava flows, emerald Mzima Springs, and lush rhino sanctuaries.
tsavo-west.signatureExperience: Watching hippos swim underwater from the submerged hide at Mzima Springs
tsavo-west.bestTime: June to October and January to February.
tsavo-west.name: Tsavo West National Park
tsavo-west.tagline: Land of lava springs and red dust tuskers
